title: Korean - 2021 Pokémon Eevee Heroes Raichu Rare #027/069
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Korean Pokémon TCG card features Raichu, a Stage 2 Hero type Pokémon with a Lightning attribute. The card is from the Eevee Heroes set, manufactured by Nintendo in 2021. It has a standard size with a holo finish and is graded as not graded. The card is in the Korean language and has the card number 069. 

It is a rare card and suitable for players aged 4+. The card is not autographed and does not come with any grading. This card is perfect for collectors and players who are looking for a unique addition to their collection.
